description: Patch schema for local Chatterbox multilingual text-to-speech with a reference audio prompt.

unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_length: The pinned FL_ChatterboxMultilingualTTS node does not expose a duration control; output length follows text, language, and reference prosody.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speed: The multilingual node exposes cfg_weight/pace, not a direct speed control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.remove_silence: The pinned Chatterbox node pack does not expose silence trimming in this node.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speech_to_speech_vc: Multilingual reference audio is zero-shot TTS conditioning, not two-audio speech-to-speech voice conversion.

output.contract: Return one readable FLAC audio artifact generated by the local Chatterbox multilingual TTS node with a reference audio prompt.
